ETH1.notes: Carries all PLC traffic: IDE, Modbus TCP, MQTT

ETH2.notes: Unplugged; no answer to ping is expected

COM2.wiredTo: USB-RS485 adapter BG041BD0 (PC COM12) and the Ebyte ME31 thermocouple module (9600 8N1, unit 1), in parallel
COM2.polarity: The PLC terminal on the adapter's TX+ is the + line; on an Ebyte device that is A
COM2.verified: 2026-10-20: transmits (requests intact on the bus) but never receives: RXD LED stays dark while a real ME31 and a simulator answer on the wire. Fails identically with a native Modbus_COM master after a clean power cycle, ModbusFB, and raw SysCom (vendor sequence). Configuration matches AutomationDirect docs, BCNF and PLC_DEH. Pin 3 to GND idle = +1.08 V: RS485 mode is applied. Next: RJ12 in RS485, another unit. See docs/modbus-bench.md, The PLC's own serial port.

BG01GGR2.label: Bench RS485 adapter on the NE2-D11P bus (simulated units 1-10)

BG00XX03.label: Bench RS485 adapter on the NA111-E bus (simulated unit 11)

BG041BD0.label: RS485 adapter on the PLC's terminal block (PLC COM2), 9600 8N1
BG041BD0.notes: Simulates the PLC's own serial devices (examples/plc_architecture/bench/bus_sim.py) or listens (bench/sniff_serial.py) when no simulator owns it. TX+ = the + line.
